name: bridge-fin
description: Financial-workflow skill series: configurable market/account data sources (MCP, direct HTTP, or local Python), portfolio/account reporting and DCF valuation bridged into anthropics/financial-services, standalone strategy backtesting, and a shared Finnhub REST query skill.

interface.longDescription: Five skills for financial workflows over your own configured data sources. Set up market and account sources once — an MCP connection, a direct HTTP API, or a local Python package — then pull balances, positions, and activity into a portfolio report, build a DCF valuation (refusing to fabricate cash flows for assets that are not DCF-shaped), or backtest a rule-based strategy for CAGR, Sharpe, max drawdown, and win rate. Reporting and valuation bridge into the anthropics/financial-services marketplace where it is installed, and render standalone where it is not. All Finnhub REST access is owned by a single shared skill so endpoint and auth handling lives in one place. Backtesting is simulation-only and never places live orders.
defaultPrompt: Build a DCF valuation for this ticker.
Set up my finance data sources.
